label: Local source cache record type policy

type_meanings.approved_api_result_future: Future approved API fixture/result vocabulary only.
type_meanings.approved_metadata_probe_result_future: Future approved metadata probe vocabulary only.
type_meanings.source_access_posture_record: Source access posture and block summary.
type_meanings.source_health_record: Repo-local health/status summary, not live monitoring.
type_meanings.static_dump_record_future: Future approved static dump vocabulary only.

ambiguity_rules: Prefer connector_fixture_record for committed connector fixture outputs.
When type is unclear, use source_metadata and keep review gates enabled.
notes: Types classify records for review; they do not establish source authority.
